facts.fact: Standard RAM is volatile and loses its contents when power is removed.
CPUs are optimized for sequential single-thread workloads; GPUs are optimized for massively parallel workloads.
SSDs store data in NAND flash memory, not on magnetic platters.
Passwords must be stored as salted hashes, never in plaintext.
In Python, iteration is generally faster than recursion due to function call overhead.
O(1) constant time is asymptotically faster than O(n) linear time.
CPU clock speed is measured in Hertz, while storage capacity is measured in bytes.
Python and JavaScript are typically interpreted or JIT-compiled, not compiled to native machine code ahead of time.
A git commit hash is computed from the file tree, parent commits, author, timestamp, and message.
SQL databases typically provide strong ACID transaction guarantees.
Encrypted data is only as secure as the protection of its keys.
